overview.title: Support queue
overview.intro: Open a support ticket, follow its comments, and keep urgent lesson issues visible to the operations team.

tickets.title: Tickets and comments
tickets.body: Track account, scheduling, academic, payment, privacy, content, and technical questions in one thread.

lessonNow.title: Lesson starting now
lessonNow.body: This urgent option is targeted for a response within 15 support-hours minutes.

incidents.title: Incident workflow
incidents.body: Safety reports create a critical incident with recorded actions and escalation.

overview.safety: Safety reports are placed first in the queue and escalated immediately. If someone is in immediate danger, contact local emergency services.
